gallery.connectWithLinkHelp: Paste a setup link from an app that is not listed here.

oauth.startFailed: Paperclip couldn’t start secure sign-in. Try again.

zapier.title: Connect Zapier
zapier.subtitle: Paste the complete MCP URL Zapier gives you, including its token.
zapier.urlHelp: The token is part of the URL. Paperclip stores it securely and checks the connection before enabling actions.
zapier.invalidUrl: Paste a valid Zapier URL to continue.

errors.oauthComingSoon: This app needs you to sign in - coming soon.
errors.checkKey: Please check your key and try again.

connection.name: Name
connection.linkNameHelp: We filled this in from the link. Change it if you’d like.
connection.appNameHelp: We filled this in from the app. Change it to tell connections apart.
connection.keyHelp: Paste the key this app gave you.
connection.noKeyHelp: Most apps just work from the link — pick Yes only if the app gave you a key.
connection.replaceKeyHelp: You can replace it anytime from this app’s page.
connection.checkLinkHelp: We’ll check the link before turning anything on.
connection.checkKeyHelp: We’ll check the key before turning anything on.
connection.noKeyRequired: This app doesn’t need a key. Just connect to continue.

googleSheets.title: Connect Google Sheets
googleSheets.invalidLink: That doesn't look like a Google Sheets link.
googleSheets.missingLink: Paste at least one Google Sheets link.
googleSheets.shareEmail: Share each sheet with this email
googleSheets.shareHelp: In Google Sheets, click Share and add this email as an Editor. Then paste the sheet links below.
googleSheets.unavailable: Google Sheets is not available on this instance yet.
googleSheets.linksLabel: Paste links to the sheets you shared
googleSheets.linksHelp: Paste one link per line. Both .../edit and .../edit#gid=... links work.

actions.intro: Read-only actions are on. Anything that can change something starts off — turn on the ones you want.
actions.readOnlyHint: these can look but not change anything
actions.canChangeHint: these change something in another app
actions.newActionsHelp: If {{name}} adds new actions later, they start off until you review them.

access.title: Who can use {{name}}?
access.changeLater: You can change this later from the app’s page.
access.allAgentsHelp: Anyone you’ve added to Paperclip can use {{name}} in their tasks. This is what most teams want.
access.specificAgentsHelp: Tick the agents who can use {{name}}.

install.title: Install {{name}} tools?
install.subtitle: Access is permission. Install decides whose runs actually carry these tools.
install.infoNotice: Installing adds {{name}}'s tools to the agent's context on every run — install only where it will actually be used.
install.notYetHelp: Keep {{name}} permitted only. You can install it later from the app or agent page.
install.specificAgentsHelp: Tick the agents that should load {{name}} every run.
install.allAgentsHelp: Adds context cost to every run of every agent — a deliberate choice. New agents you add later are installed automatically.
install.autoExtendNotice: Installing on {{name}} will also grant access. A tool can't be installed on an agent that isn't allowed to use it, so we'll add {{name}} to who can use it. This is logged.

success.notInstalledHelp: Agents can use it after you install it on their Tools tab.
success.installedHelp: Installed agents will load it on their next run.
